title: Till

scan.label: Scan or search
scan.placeholder: Scan a barcode or type a name, SKU (F3)
scan.hint: Scan, or type and press Enter. ↓ ↑ choose a result.

quick.label: Quick sale

reasons.empty: Type a name and a price.
reasons.price_missing: Price missing — end with the price, e.g. 450.
reasons.name_missing: Type the item name before the price.
reasons.name_too_long: The name can have at most 80 characters.

quick.promoted: Now a product: {{name}} ({{price}}). Scan it, or press ↓ then Enter.

customer.label: Customer phone
customer.name: Name (optional)
customer.invalid: Not a Sri Lankan number yet

cart.title: Cart
cart.empty: Scan an item to start a sale.

totals.needsApproval: Above your discount limit: a supervisor will approve at payment.

line.title: Edit line
line.reasonRequired: Give a reason for selling below the list price.
line.belowMin: Below the minimum price of {{price}}: needs a supervisor.

bill.title: Bill discount
bill.invalid: Enter an amount such as 150 or a percentage such as 5%.
bill.tooBig: The discount can't be more than the bill.

pay.title: Payment
pay.notEnough: Payments don't cover the amount due yet.
pay.tooMuch: Card, transfer and QR payments can't exceed what is due.
pay.salespersonHint: Type the staff number of the person who made this sale (1, 2, 3 …).

recall.title: Held sales
recall.swap: The sale in progress will be held.

recover.message: A sale in progress was found from before the app closed.

void.title: Void a sale
void.help: A void cancels a whole sale from this counter's open session. Returned goods go through an exchange, never a refund.
void.empty: No sales in this session yet.

keys.void: Void a sale from this session (toggle)
keys.cancel: Cancel / back to the scan field

noSession: Open a cash session before selling.

disambiguation.title: Select product
disambiguation.description: {{count}} products share the barcode {{code}}. Which one is it?

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.help: Item for item, within 7 days of the sale. The customer pays only the difference. There are no cash refunds and no credit notes.
exchange.receiptHint: Scan the bill barcode, or type it: T01-261121004. A short form like T01-4 finds today's bill 4.
exchange.late: More than {{days}} days ago. A supervisor or owner PIN is needed to finish this exchange.
exchange.notReturnable: Can't be returned (not a stocked item)
exchange.nothing: Nothing on this sale can be exchanged.
exchange.rule: The replacement goods must be worth at least this much. Scan them next.
exchange.tooLow: The replacement must be worth at least {{credit}}. Add more items.
exchange.finishFirst: Finish or cancel the exchange first.
